Virtual BMW 3 Series G50 Returns to the Beloved 'Round' Angel Eyes, Though Only in Fantasy Land
6 photos
Photo: kelsonik / Instagram
The premium Bavarian automaker BMW has a lot of Neue Klasse novelties, but its latest addition to the new lifestyle is becoming an interesting target across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI for the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators.
It’s possible that BMW has attracted a lot of attention due to the controversies surrounding not just the fresh Neue Klasse models but also the previous lot of disconnected styling ideas. The Neue Klasse, meanwhile, unifies the design in just two directions: SUVs get a slim and vertical kidney grille treatment akin to older models, while passenger cars like the i3 and the latest 3 Series pack wide kidneys.
There has been much debate around the second-generation BMW i3, which has morphed into a classic sedan as the electric version of the 3 Series, and the Bavarians actually surprised everyone when the regular G50 model with ICE under the hood was presented looking almost the same as the EV models. The difference is subtle but visible – the G50 has better proportions due to additional space behind the front wheels, making it feel more planted.
It also helps that the new BMW M350 xDrive from the M Performance roster feels more like an M3 than ever – it even comes with 437 hp under the hood, which isn’t too far away from the G80 BMW M3 sedan’s base version, which packs 473 hp! The aero kit and the other goodies also make it a very good option, together with the grin-inducing BMW M Drift Moment feature, and it also doesn’t have the same harsh ride as the full M3.
Anyway, there are folks who still don’t appreciate the styling of the Neue Klasse BMW 3 Series even in M350 form, and a virtual artist has decided to find a solution to the predicament. Not long ago, the virtual artist Timur Altynbayev from Kazakhstan presented his unofficial, hypothetical M350 design project as a return to the E30 age with LED-infused small kidney grilles and dual round headlights, inadvertently also bringing back the beloved ‘ Angel Eyes .’
Those were a feature that appeared much later on the E90 series with factory halo/corona rings and evolved with the F30 into round-to-square LED angel eyes, while the fan base also equipped the E46 iteration with aftermarket LED or CCFL halo kits. Now, here’s also Nikita Chuicko, the virtual artist better known as " kelsonik " on social media, who thinks that now is the right CGI time to work on BMW's latest 3 Series (G50) with modern angel eyes.
So, he transforms the front bumper and also adapts the kidney grille to allow the placement of separate dual LED headlights equipped with LED angel eyes as daytime running lights, mirroring the F30 iteration while also taking some inspiration from the E30 series. What do you think – yay or nay? View this post on Instagram A post shared by CAR DESIGN | RENDERINGS (@kelsonik)
